engine:
The midrashim transform as an executable: a seed read from a seated text, operators applied to it in a declared order, an emission predicted,
and the emission checked against the seated target and against controls. Nothing is asserted that the run does not show.

A seed is one or more verses with MEMBERS, each a named piece of wording given as a pattern over the Greek with accents and case removed.
An operator changes the list of members. The emission is the list after the last operator: which members are kept and in what order, which are
dropped, which are replaced, what marker is added. The target passes a check when the seated verse shows that. Controls are other verses (the
Septuagint source, the Synoptic parallel, the upstream text) scored against the same emission: a control that scores as well as the target is an
equally good source or an equally good borrower, and the run says so.
    python3 midrash.py <alexanarch root> <derivations.json> <out.json>

operators.PARTITION: keep some members of the seed's sentence and drop the others; another borrower may keep what this one drops
operators.REORDER: set the kept members in a new order
operators.SUBSTITUTE: replace one member by another of the same function (a word for a word)
operators.SUBSTITUTE-OBJECT: keep the verb and its frame and change the object it acts on
operators.TRANSFER-ATTRIBUTE: move an attribute from the figure of the vision to a figure of the narrative
operators.EVENT: set a sign of the vision as an event at a hinge of the narrative (no change of wording; the change is of place)
operators.CITE-AS-SCRIPTURE: mark the member as written or promised: the borrower reports what the seed performs
operators.REVERSE-DOER: keep the deed and its object and change who does it, from the adversary to the Christ or back
operators.UNDO: remove the seed's 'no more': what a judgment takes away is present in the borrower
operators.STATION: make one into several, each answerable for itself (one lampstand of seven lamps into seven lampstands)
operators.HIDE: what the source says is not known, the borrower says is hidden and promised
operators.ADD: add a member the seed does not have (recorded, so that an addition is never silent)
operators.NEGATE: deny for the borrower's own what the seed inflicts: the harm stays in the words and a 'not' is set on it

frozen.rule: operators and members declared before the run (#1494's rule); a derivation changed after a run is a new derivation
